mentions.name: agent-auth
mentions.description: An SSH agent proxy that lets headless AI coding agents request SSH signatures without credentials living on the server. The agent sees a normal SSH_AUTH_SOCK and supplies context about why it needs a signature; agent-auth proxies the request to the 1Password SSH agent on an available Mac, or otherwise routes it to Agent Witness on the phone. Also supports sudo through pam_ssh_agent_auth.
mentions.problem: Giving a headless agent access to SSH credentials without leaving private keys and other credentials on the server.
mentions.source_excerpt: For SSH (and sudo through pam_ssh_agent_auth), I ended up building agent-auth and Agent Witness. Codex sees a normal SSH_AUTH_SOCK and supplies some context about why it needs a signature. If one of my Macs is available, agent-auth proxies the request to the 1Password SSH agent there. Otherwise it routes the request to Agent Witness on my phone.
